_readme: The demo played from an Xbox pad, through the input map. Every other session presses
ACTIONS, which name the action and skip the map, so none of them could tell whether a pad
button reached the game; pad_press, stick and key_press send the real events. It is in
pack_check's list because the pack's input map is the deployed one.
What it proves: A starts the game and talks; the words on screen follow the device that
spoke last (the pad's after A, the keyboard's after Escape); a full push and a half push of
the stick both walk, at one speed; Menu opens the pause menu and, on its top page, closes it;
the D-pad moves its cursor. Village row 5 is open east of the spawn, so the walk is east on
a full push and back west on a half push.

steps.text: A on the title: the cursor opens on New game. The pad has spoken, so every word is the pad's from here.
the hint on the map, in the pad's words, and the keyboard's gone
half a push walks too, at the one walking speed, so the way back is a half push
Menu pauses; the pause menu's line is in the pad's words
Menu again on the top page closes it - the toggle
Escape, a real key: the words flip back to the keyboard's
